title: Candlewick — chapter 3: The Audition
premise: Ollie follows Milo up the Hill in secret
cliffhanger: Then the Whale stepped out of the elevator. He said four words. Find who never loses.
nextOptions: Ollie sneaks back down before anyone sees him
A Bot finds Ollie behind the planter
Milo spots Ollie and says nothing

scenes.line: In my town, nobody from the Flats goes up the Hill. Milo went anyway. I followed him.
scenes.setting: the gold staircase from the Flats to the Hill
scenes.action: Milo climbs, Ollie hides behind mail parcels

scenes.line: Up there, the water is clean. The charts are always green. Even the fountains are gold.
scenes.setting: the gold fountain plaza on the Hill
scenes.action: Ollie peeks from behind the fountain

scenes.line: The Callers took Milo to their rooftop. They gave him a ring light and a coin to call.
scenes.action: the Callers put a ring light on Milo and hand him a coin

scenes.line: Before Milo said a word, three wallets bought the coin. Theirs.
scenes.setting: behind a plant on the rooftop
scenes.action: Ollie sees three Caller wallets buy first, his eye glows green

scenes.line: Milo called it. The whole Flats bought it. From up here, you can watch them.
scenes.action: Milo calls the coin, the Flats light up below

scenes.line: Then the Callers sold. All at once. Milo was still smiling on the big screen.
scenes.action: the Callers sell at once, the chart crashes red, Milo still smiling on screen

scenes.line: Then the Whale stepped out of the elevator. He said four words. Find who never loses.
scenes.action: the Whale steps out of a gold elevator, Ollie frozen behind the plant
